pairs.why: Both calculators have labelled, pressable keys, a display and a solar strip, and neither one has a clear construction fault.
B's keys have no labels, so the calculator could not be used, while A's number and operator keys are all marked.
A hangs flat on the wall like the real clock, but B is a round clock standing on its edge on the floor with no stand to hold it.
In A the life ring hangs by a rope from a metal hook on the post and the plank deck sits on its posts, while B's ring and rope are loosely placed on the deck edge.
B is mounted flat on the wall, but A is a round clock balanced on its edge on the floor with no stand.
A is a believable coil whose loop is held by a red binding, while B's coil, honda ring and loop have unclear rope routing and a loose dangling tail.
A's X-legs, pivot and armrests make a plausible folding camp chair, while B's backrest posts end at the seat and don't clearly connect to the crossed legs.
In A the rope clearly runs from the tied coil through the honda ring into the loop, while B's coil and loop routing is muddled where the rope passes through the ring.
